run_f_gold_search: run f_gold to search for a target value x in an array where adjacent elements differ by at most k
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct index or -1 results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which performs optimized array search using the adjacent difference k to skip elements
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it uses abs(arr[i] - x) / k to jump ahead during search
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the TOFILL placeholder f_filled with a working implementation
